1. Preliminary — the exterior only, and the first drawing in
the set to show the villa against the houses it actually
2. The house is not in the middle of its plot. It sits hard
against the east boundary with a 1.00 m paved side
passage, and the whole 11.50 m entrance garden is on the
west, gated from the west boundary with a walk running
3. East: a single storey in clay brick, 1.00 m away. That is
what lets the east wall be glazed at all — our lowest east
sill at +4.20 clears its roof by 1.20 m. We stand 14.05 m
over it, which is worth seeing before the elevations are
4. West: 3 storeys and blind toward us, drawn in thin line
because it stands back behind the garden. Nothing of ours
opens that way in any case — the west wall takes louvred
5. North: a single storey as well, confirmed by the client
and not drawn on this south-facing view. The north wall
carries windows on all five levels; only the ground floor
looks at anything, and from +3.30 up they clear its roof
as the east windows clear the east neighbour's.
6. The garden wall height is indicative and awaits the
client's choice. Boundaries to be confirmed by measured
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
